adobe:R172301.title: Principal AI Product Manager, Agentic Governance
adobe:R172301.desc:
The Opportunity 
 We are seeking a Principal AI Product Manager to lead the charge in building Agentic Governance within Adobe's Experience Platform team in Bucharest. You'll define how enterprises grant identity, permissions, and accountability to AI agents, protecting millions of customer records along the way. This role gives you the chance to create a brand-new product category from the ground up. You will partner closely with engineering and security leaders. You will also develop how the industry thinks about trustworthy AI.
 What you'll do 
 Define the strategy and roadmap for how Adobe governs AI agents, from identity and permissions to accountability, and turn it into shipped product.
 Meet regularly with enterprise customers to run discovery sessions, and capture their governance and compliance needs in clear PRDs.
 Translate customer use cases into detailed requirements, then partner with engineering to specify exactly how agents should behave and where the guardrails sit.
 Partner with Sales, Technical Account Management, and Support to bring enterprise field feedback into the roadmap.
 Guide new features through privacy, security, and ethics review, and help enterprise customers pass their own security and compliance reviews with confidence.
 Share strategy and results with senior leadership and industry analysts, and own go-to-market with Product Marketing.
 Mentor other product managers and share lessons learned about governing AI agents.
 What you'll bring 
 8+ years of product management experience, 5+ years in enterprise B2B products, including work in data platform, compliance, cybersecurity, IAM, fraud/risk, or regulated industries.
 Ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable business impact.
 Understanding of how AI agents work to define their permissions and guardrails.
 Working knowledge of AI and privacy regulations such as GDPR and how enterprise security reviews work.
 Proven ability to align teams and leaders across the business, and drive decisions to closure
 Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information in a fast paced space.
 Preferred experience with Responsible AI frameworks or agent orchestration tools and frameworks.
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

adyen:7862254.title: Group Product Manager - Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud
adyen:7862254.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.  
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 The Opportunity 
 Adyen operates as a full-stack payment processor and licensed global banking institution, capturing the behavior and complex interactions of billions of shoppers and millions of businesses worldwide. As we scale our footprint in banking, card issuing, and embedded financial products, the financial risk profiles we manage are significantly higher than traditional payment processing alone. We are leveraging our unique position to build advanced, data-driven risk management capabilities to proactively detect and mitigate platform fraud and commercial risk. 
 We are looking for a Group Product Manager (GPM) to lead and develop a senior team of product managers within Adyen’s Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud group. This is not a standard product role. We need an all-around biztech leader who possesses strong technical instincts but treats the domain like a high-growth business, balancing architecture with a commercial mindset, regulatory strategy, and high-friction cross-functional alignment. 
 What You'll Do 
 Drive Commercial Excellence: Formulate and execute a strategic vision that transforms risk mitigation into customer value. Treat these premium, paid capabilities like your own business, balancing pricing strategy, revenue drivers, and costs to ensure responsible growth.
 Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Direct, coach, and elevate a team of high-performing product managers within Adyen’s Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud group.
 Architect Smart Trade-offs: Simplify an ambiguous space by defining clear, actionable use cases with your engineering and partner teams. Strategically decide when to deploy automated technical solutions (such as AI/ML models) versus operational support to optimize merchant value.
 Pragmatic Regulatory Strategy: Act as the ultimate product authority for Commercial Risk & Platform Fraud across Adyen. Partner closely with Compliance, Regulatory, and Operations teams to design resilient, auditable capabilities, bringing a pragmatic commercial lens to regulatory interpretation rather than blindly following rigid frameworks.
 Lead Through Friction: Drive alignment and partner closely with Engineering, Commercial, Risk, and Operations teams without direct authority. Raise the bar for product clarity and prioritization discipline, making the tough, objective trade-offs necessary to unlock long-term value, even when it means saying "no" to specific groups.
 Who You Are 
 Accelerated Product Leader: You have 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of progression into leadership roles. You have launched and evolved complex products across every stage of the product lifecycle.
 People Manager & Coach: You bring hands-on experience hiring, managing, and developing product managers of various levels, with a proven ability to build a collaborative culture of growth, coaching, and mentorship.
 Commercial GM Mindset: You bring a highly analytical, metrics-driven approach to decision-making. You deeply understand revenue drivers, costs, and portfolio management, behaving with the strategic accountability of a P&L owner to optimize business outcomes.
 Strong Tech & AI/ML Instincts: You have a solid conceptual grasp of machine learning, AI, and advanced data-science models. While you don't need to be an ML engineer, you have the technical confidence to collaborate with engineering teams on building products rooted in petabyte-scale datasets.
 Master of Influence: You are a clear, confident, and fearless communicator across technical, commercial, and executive audiences globally. You have a track record of driving cross-functional alignment and managing complex stakeholders without direct authority.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments  
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

 Senior Product Manager - Developer Experience 
 The Internal Developer Platform (IDP) cluster is on a mission to create standardized, scalable, and delightful experiences across the software development life cycle (SDLC) so Adyen engineers are empowered to deliver value more efficiently and reliably for our customers.
 As a Senior Product Manager within the IDP cluster, you will manage a key stream of our platform evolution. Your goal is to transition our engineering organization from fragmented, "tribal knowledge" based flows to a cohesive, automated ecosystem that reduces cognitive load, minimizes manual toil, and ensures our platform scales with our global engineering footprint. 2026 is our year of deep optimization and resilience; you are a product leader who understands that scaling a platform requires balancing innovation with mandatory reliability and stability mandates
 What you’ll do: 
 Optimize the SDLC: Drive initiatives to reduce SDLC friction, such as reducing CI flakiness and improving build insights, to help teams shift from centralized, manual processes to systemic, automated "golden paths".
 Drive Product Maturity: Take ownership of product lifecycle management by assessing the maturity of our toolset, executing on necessary deprecations, and ensuring our core products have clear adoption paths and value propositions.
 Build Technical Context: Partner with IDP engineering to bridge the gap between generic AI models and Adyen’s complex architecture. You will prioritize the rollout of AGENTS.md standards, internal RAG pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for tools like GitLab and Jira.
 Foster Developer Autonomy: Work across the organization to bridge the gap between infrastructure and developer needs, building "LEGO-block" style abstractions that allow teams to own their pipelines and release cycles while maintaining secure, compliant guardrails.
 Validate ROI & Manage Vendors: Implement data-driven feedback loops to track adoption and measure SDLC improvements against core metrics like DXI, Change Failure Rate, and developer velocity
 Who you are: 
 10+ years of product experience ideally within Platform Engineering, Developer Experience (DevEx), or AI-enabled technical products.
 You are technically credible. You can confidently spar with engineers about system architecture, CI/CD pipeline constraints, and the balance between centralized governance and team autonomy.
 You are a master of change management. You know how to influence developer habits and drive adoption in highly opinionated technical environments.
 You are data-driven, capable of translating subjective developer feedback and system/usage data into clear impact metrics.
 You thrive in ambiguity. You can execute quickly without waiting for perfect information and adapt quickly to new information
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

  Build for Scale & Customer-Centric

 Optimize System Performance: Collaborate with engineering to maximize the performance, reliability, and scalability of our out-of-flow split generation infrastructure.
 Evolve Self-Service Tooling: Contribute to customer-facing automated splits tooling in the Customer Area to help platforms easily configure, version, and manage their monetization strategies.
 Engage with Platforms: Interact directly with platforms to understand their pain points in split payments, gather feedback on dashboards, and translate their needs into core product requirements.

 End-to-End Ownership: Take full ownership of specific initiatives from initial scoping through final delivery, seamlessly managing timelines and stakeholder expectations.
 Who you are 
 Experienced Product Leader: You have a minimum of 12 years of experience in a product management or client-facing product role, ideally in B2B dealing with complex enterprise software, payments, fintech, marketplaces, or SaaS platforms.  Senior Product Manager, FX 
 This is a high impact role based in Amsterdam and part of the FX and Cash Management team. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about financial technology, adopts an AI-first product development mindset, and is excited about Adyen’s opportunity to grow its financial products business by 10x in the next 2-5 yrs.
 In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining a reliable FX trading platform, enabling the whole company to use your services. You will also be responsible for creating the vision, strategy and implementation of the cash management tooling, working closely with the Treasury department but also with our merchants to identify their needs. 
 What You'll Do: 
 Set strategy and roadmap for the FX and cash management team.
 Lead execution working closely with the Engineering, Product, Treasury, Finance and Commercial teams, to deliver a cohesive FX platform that scales globally without compromising reliability or trust.
 Establish governance for FX across multiple teams and departments , defining success and operational metrics, driving alignment across Adyen.
 Build a first-in-class Treasury Management System that serves both the needs of our customers and our internal teams.
 What Success Looks Like:  
 Within the first 6-12 months, you will have:
 Established a clear vision, strategy and goals for the FX and cash management team
 Identified key customer and operational pain points helping shape the product roadmap
 Build a well oiled product development team that can execute on the roadmap
 Who you are 
 Experience - 8+ years building high-scale platforms in fast growing tech or fintech environments. 2+ years of experience in FX and/or cash management 
 Execution - track record of delivering complex product and platform initiatives at scale. Comfortable operating in ambiguity with high autonomy and ownership.
 Customer centric: You are able to translate technical complexity back to customer impact and understand the needs of different customers.
 Product - PM at heart with strong product instincts, data-based decision mindset, and highly focused on business impact. Demonstrated passion for AI-forward thinking.
 Leadership - demonstrated ability of setting vision and strategy for teams. Strong sense of initiative and self-motivation.
 Communication - a clear, compelling communicator who is comfortable interacting with both internal and external stakeholders from varying disciplines and cultures.
 Mindset - entrepreneurial mindset  with a strong bias toward action and ability to move fast in the midst of ambiguity.

adyen:8244728.desc:

 Product Manager - Interface Foundations 
 The world's largest businesses run on Adyen. They manage their business in our portal, embed our components in their interfaces to serve their own users, and send their shoppers through our checkout. To them, it's all one product. It's built by many teams working in parallel, and whether it feels like one product depends on the foundations they share. You'll own the design system and technical frameworks those teams build on. You'll decide what gets built next, get teams across Adyen building on it, and set the standards that keep the experience consistent without slowing anyone down. Get this right, and building a great experience at Adyen becomes the default. Teams ship faster because they aren't rebuilding the basics, and merchants get an experience that holds together wherever they meet us.
 What you'll do 
 Own the design system and technical frameworks the rest of Adyen leverages to build first-class customer experiences. Decide what gets built next across UI components and the technical infrastructure that powers our customer experiences, and treat the engineers and designers who build on them as your customers.
 Sweat the details end customers see. Hold every component to a high bar, because it ends up in front of merchants, their users and their shoppers.
 Set standards that accelerate. Define what good looks like for interfaces at Adyen, and build the review and governance that teams experience as help rather than a gate.
 Drive adoption without authority. Support teams with their own roadmaps and priorities to build on the shared foundations you provide.
 Measure what matters. Set clear metrics for adoption, speed and experience quality, and use them to decide where to invest and when to reset course.
 Work across disciplines. Partner closely with engineering and design within the team, and with product, design and engineering leads across Adyen.
 Go deep with your customers. Understand the engineers and designers who build on your foundations, and the merchants and shoppers who use what they build.
 Who you are 
 Platform Product Experience. You've built products whose customers are other developers or teams, and you understand what that demands: clear contracts, careful change, and not breaking the people downstream of you.
 Design Sensibility & Craft. You have a strong eye for interface quality and care about details end customers will notice. You can hold a component to a high bar and explain why it matters.
 Adoption and Influence. Demonstrated ability to get teams you don't control to adopt something, in a high-autonomy, bottom-up culture.
 Judgment on Standards. You know when a standard makes teams faster and when it's in the way, and you're comfortable holding the tension between the two.
 Product Execution. Able to take an open-ended problem, turn it into a clear plan, and ship with velocity across multiple teams.
 Analytical Rigor. Set clear metrics and use data to align on priorities, measure impact, and change course as needed.
 Customer Obsession. You want to understand both the engineers building on your platform and the merchants and shoppers at the end of it.
 Bonus 
 Experience owning a design system, component library, or UI framework
 A background in frontend engineering or product design
 Experience in payments, fintech, or another regulated domain

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices.  - Rapidly iterate on new billing features (e.g., subscription management, smart invoicing, flexible pricing models) and AI-powered enhancements based on user feedback and data.

 - Manage and mentor a high-performing team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, and responsible AI adoption in fintech, payments, and billing.



Minimum Qualifications

 - 5–10 years of experience in Product Management, with exposure to payments, billing, invoicing, or financial services.

 - Proven track record of taking products from ideation to delivery at scale, ideally in global payments, billing platforms, or digital wallets.

 - Experience building or managing billing systems (subscription billing, invoicing, automated reconciliation, recurring payments).

 - Strong ability to balance long-term product vision with short-term growth and execution needs.

 - Comfortable working in data-driven, cross-functional teams, leveraging analytics or AI-powered billing tools to guide decisions.

 - Flexibility to work across multiple time zones.

 - Exceptional communication skills, able to articulate complex billing, payments, and AI product strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences.



Preferred Qualifications

This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.

The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.

* Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network

 Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. The candidate will be responsible for building market-first customer offerings right from concept to launch. amazon:10504416.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Global Transportation Technology Services
amazon:10504416.desc:
Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network - figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network - from evaluating new lanes to implementing them in production. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in Germany, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.
The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real-time, and keeping systems running 24/7.
We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.
Key job responsibilities
As a leader on the team, you will be expected to operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product portfolio. You will be a key player in driving strategic planning, project execution, driving operational excellence, and shaping up the solutions to achieve our vision. This is your opportunity to make a big impact and make history in the world of Global Transportation!

amazon:10531853.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Just Walk Out Technology
amazon:10531853.desc:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset. 
Just Walk Out (JWO) enables shopping in retail stores with no lines and no checkout. You simply use a credit card to enter the store, take what you want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and leave the store. This checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects whether products are taken or returned and enables shoppers to grab and go from stores ranging from small airport kiosks to massive university stores. 
The Merchant In-Store Operations team within JWO owns the tools, systems, and workflows that enable merchants and their store associates to operate autonomous retail environments at scale. The role spans directly working with two engineering teams that are responsible for unattended store operations, planogram and product layout tooling, and in-store associate experience and education. Together, these teams serve JWO's growing global footprint, supporting diverse retail configurations—from fully staffed locations to completely unattended kiosks and micro-markets—enabling merchants across Sports, Education, Travel, Healthcare, and Hospitality verticals to run Just Walk Out stores efficiently and confidently. This Senior Product Manager-Tech will own the product vision spanning both teams, defining how merchants and store teams interact with, monitor, and maintain their autonomous retail environments day to day and how customer support and tech operations teams diagnose and resolve issues at speed. 
You will define the product roadmap spanning two engineering teams—In-Store Operations—covering unattended store operations, store associate tooling, planogram management, store availability, and customer support experience capabilities that scale from hundreds to thousands of stores with vastly different operational models. You will work with Enterprise Customers, System Integrators, Engineering, Solution Architects, Customer Support, and Tech Operations teams to drive the long-term Merchant In-Store Operations vision as JWO expands from 350+ stores today to thousands of stores globally. This role requires deep understanding of physical retail operations, store-level workflows, customer support systems, and the ability to design intuitive tools that empower merchants, frontline associates, and support teams to succeed in autonomous retail environments. 
As a tenured Product Manager, you are familiar with the product development lifecycle. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and
movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Hundreds of millions of customers open Prime Video every week. They trust us to help them find something great to watch. Increasingly, they expect us to help them discover title offers, channel and bundle subscriptions that match their interests. 
Today, we break that trust in small but compounding ways. A customer declines an offer and sees it again minutes later. A new subscriber gets upsells before finding a show they love. A loyal viewer showing signs of leaving receives a generic message that ignores everything they have ever watched.

You will prove — through measurable customer outcomes — that respecting customer drives better business results than pressuring them.

Crack problems others haven't, drive adoption at scale enabling Partner content discovery for the growing number of channels across 30+ countries. Personalized offer timing that converts because it's welcome

amazon:10541182.desc:
Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain team and shape the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will define product strategy and drive performance for the buying and inventory planning systems at the core of the pharmacy supply chain: procurement systems that decide what to buy and when under expiry and regulatory constraints, inventory planning that sets optimal stock levels across the network, and placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers. These systems are informed by demand forecasts that predict prescription volume, but your focus is turning that signal into smart purchasing and inventory decisions.

We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager - Tech to own the product strategy for how Amazon Pharmacy determines optimal inventory levels, decides what and when to buy, simulates network decisions, and identifies unhealthy inventory — with demand forecasting as a key input to those decisions. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers and scientists building the underlying optimization and ML systems.

amazon:10571904.desc:
Ready to build Amazon's next $100B business? We're not just entering shipping, we're transforming how billions of packages move around the globe. By evolving Amazon's legendary fulfillment engine into an agile, intelligent shipping network, we're creating a system that continuously optimizes to deliver on time, every time, for every business and every customer. Every shipment is more than just a box, it spins the flywheel faster, enhancing our logistics network through scale, speed, and intelligence. As we increase density and reach, we're revolutionizing shipping for all businesses while strengthening Amazon's own delivery capabilities, reducing costs and accelerating deliveries across our entire ecosystem.
WHAT WILL YOU DO?
We're hiring a Senior Product Manager for Billing and Accounting in Amazon Shipping. This role exists to make getting paid effortless and trustworthy for our shippers, and predictable and well-controlled for the business, as we consolidate fragmented, region-specific billing systems into a more standardized flow.
You'll own execution of defined product workstreams across the invoice-to-cash lifecycle: how charges are billed, how invoices are presented, how customers pay, how disputes and adjustments are resolved, and how transactions reconcile to the ledger. You'll drive consolidation of legacy and interim billing systems, close functional gaps, and ensure accurate, compliant, and controlled financial outcomes across every marketplace we operate in. You'll turn complex billing and accounting requirements into clear product definitions, and partner across operations, pricing, payments, credit risk, accounting, tax, and engineering to deliver them.
You'll work at the intersection of finance, operations, and engineering, translating regulatory, accounting, and customer requirements into crisp product requirements, and turning them into billing experiences that scale as the business grows.
You'll collaborate closely with:
-Billing Operations teams who manage day-to-day shipper interactions on invoices, payments, and disputes
-Payments and Credit Risk product owners whose capabilities your billing workstreams depend on
-Pricing teams introducing new charges and rate structures that our systems must bill for
-Accounting teams who own the ledger and require accurate, compliant, and controlled financial records
-Tax (VAT) teams who own compliance and filings
-Engineering teams building the billing and accounting platform
-Senior leadership setting financial strategy and controls for the business
WHO ARE YOU?
You're a product leader who is equally comfortable digging into an invoice reconciliation, writing a crisp product narrative, and walking an accounting or operations leader through a control tradeoff. You have strong product sense and build the right thing, not just build the thing right, within a defined charter. You bring real financial and data fluency, enough to partner credibly with accounting, tax, and finance on controls and compliance, and with engineers on data and systems, and you understand how billing, invoicing, and reconciliation actually get done day to day. You decompose an undefined problem space into a clear, sequenced set of deliverables, define the metrics that matter, and let them guide prioritization. You communicate crisply across functional, operations, and leadership audiences, and you balance a bias for action with the judgment to know a one-way door from a two-way door. You're a strong owner who is right a lot, and you measure success by customer and business outcomes, accurate billing, on-time payment, clean reconciliation, and reduced disputes, not features shipped. You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where product decisions directly impact billing accuracy, reconciliation, dispute rates, and cash flow across a rapidly scaling business.
Key job responsibilities
Product Execution & Delivery
- Own execution of defined billing and accounting product workstreams within the charter, connecting accurate, frictionless financial experiences to growth and control across the business
- Write the product narratives and requirements that define new capabilities and drive alignment across operations, pricing, accounting, tax, and engineering
- Balance near-term operational and compliance needs with longer-term investment in a consolidated billing platform
- Work with engineering to deliver billing and accounting capabilities into the platform and the tools operations teams use every day
- Make sequencing and scope tradeoffs to deliver impact incrementally while protecting live financial operations
- Define clear acceptance criteria for operational and accounting adoption
Metrics & Business Impact
- Own billing accuracy and reconciliation outcomes as primary success measures, along with supporting measures of dispute rate and days-sales-outstanding
- Establish mechanisms for continuous visibility, baselining, and proactive risk identification

amazon:10572078.title: Product Manager - Technical, Customer Experience and Business Trends
amazon:10572078.desc:
Amazon is seeking a Product Manager – Technical to join our Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) team, a team that uses technology and innovative methods to assess and improve Amazon’s customer experience. This person should be customer-obsessed, data-oriented, technologically hands-on, and excited to innovate.
You will be a core member of our product and engineering teams, driving the success of our products, tools, and capabilities to enable our organization to deliver insights and analysis at pace. We work across multiple Amazon Stores categories (e.g., consumer electronics, apparel) and tech teams (e.g., search, personalization), partnering with senior business leaders in strategically developing and improving the shopping experience on Amazon.
As our agentic-powered product suite has rapidly grown in recent months, with ever-increasing demand from users, we are looking for a PM-T who will focus on building and enhancing features of internal products and tools that drive insights and analysis across Amazon, enabling teams globally to improve end-to-end customer experiences.
The immediate objective is to own the vision, design and implementation for our next feature release, which will be a step change in how we evaluate Personalized shopping and streaming experiences worldwide. You will work with users, engineering, and leadership to drive alignment on requirements to ensure the product meets the high bar and provides a delightful experience.
A successful PM-T will be able to deeply understand the user needs, and experiences for features of our products, dive deep into the technical design, identify trade-offs (both back end and front end), surface edge cases, drive decision making, influence, and drive long-term product roadmap and success. The role will also suit someone who enjoys collaborating across our wider suite of products and capabilities to drive impact on high priority business needs.
You should be passionate about improving Amazon’s end-to-end processes and technology, and building partnerships across business and development teams to drive changes. You have the proven ability to dive deep into complex systems and metrics and understand the business context behind the data and technology, continuously striving to find deeper insights. You will be responsible for using innovative technology and seek out best practices.
This role will allow you to make a real impact on our business from Day 1, and provide a dynamic, innovative and fast-paced environment to constantly build your skill set and address new challenges.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the experience and product design for new feature launch and rollout in our product suite.
- Deeply understand user needs and effectively translate into structured product and technical requirements, regularly driving conversations with users and diving deep on their feedback to identify and prioritize high-impact improvements.
- Play a critical role in influencing the vision and product roadmap for the future, write effective PRFAQs and technical requirements, stay at the forefront of technology advancements and push the tech frontier.
- Understand complex business problems across business units, geographies and product lines.
- Manage ambiguity and translate this into tech requirements.
- Effectively partner with users in our team to solve their problems.
- Build strong relations with internal stakeholders to understand priorities, provide inputs to our roadmap and to collaborate and work with them on studies and actions to implement product and service solutions.
- Support hiring and onboarding of new team members and contribute to our high performing culture.
- Work cross functionally with peers/colleagues globally to support best practices, and shared opportunities.
About the team
Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings - for almost every business at Amazon - for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, streamers, gamers). Our team is truly international, with members located in multiple countries around the world, enabling us to bring a global perspective to our work.

amazon:10584153.title: Principal Product Manager Tech, Amazon Supply Chain Services (MCCF)
amazon:10584153.desc:
We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Technical to join the MCCF team and lead product strategy and delivery for the UK and EU. MCF operates in the US, Canada, the UK, EU27, and Japan, with a growing presence in markets such as Mexico and Australia. International markets, led by the UK, EU, and Japan, are growing faster than the US. In this role, you will be responsible primarily for optimizing fulfillment and placement. Fulfillment covers how an order is promised, assigned to a fulfillment center, and delivered. Placement covers where inventory is positioned in the network ahead of demand. You will own the operational reliability and cost reduction goals for MCF's international markets, both of which are tracked as VP-level goals. You will define the international product roadmap, determine which problems MCCF addresses first in these markets, and lead the most complex initiatives directly.
Amazon's Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), enables every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. With ASCS, merchants can take advantage of fully automated supply chain services that get products from manufacturers to customers around the world, through end-to-end solutions including Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), Buy With Prime (BwP), Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD), Warehousing & Logistics, and more. These services keep products in stock, deliver faster and more reliable shipping, and significantly lower costs. For over 20 years, Amazon has been empowering small and medium-sized businesses with opportunities to grow. ASCS and MCCF are an exciting next step in our mission to help merchants of all sizes grow their business, whether on Amazon or beyond.
The MCCF product organization is primarily based in the US. Initiatives that extend an existing US product to international markets remain with the US product owner. This role owns initiatives that are specific to international markets, such as enabling off-Amazon merchants to place a single inventory pool across EU27 countries, and initiatives whose scale or complexity exceeds what the US team can take on alongside its own roadmap. You will set the prioritization of international work across the MCCF product organization and partner with US product leaders to align roadmaps.
Key job responsibilities
- Define and own the international product roadmap for MCF fulfillment and placement in the UK and EU, including the rationale for sequencing and investment.
- Own the cost reduction goal for international markets, tracked at VP level. MCF must lower its cost per unit every year through 2029. Placement is the primary lever. Inventory positioned in the region where the order ships costs less to deliver and arrives sooner.
- Own the operational reliability goal for international markets, tracked at VP level. Marketplaces set shipping and delivery SLAs, and merchants incur penalties when MCF misses them.
- Lead the international initiatives that are specific to the region or exceed the US team's capacity, from problem definition through launch and adoption.
- Determine, together with US product leaders, which initiatives extend from the US and which the international team owns, and ensure international requirements are reflected in US roadmaps.
- Partner with the engineering teams that own placement, forecasting, promise, and fulfillment planning systems. Evaluate design proposals, assess trade-offs, and identify when a decision requires principal engineer review.
- Author the documents that drive decisions, including PR-FAQs, strategy narratives, and annual planning inputs for international markets. Present regularly to Directors and VPs.
- Evaluate new international opportunities, such as cross-border fulfillment, and bring recommendations to leadership.

 Available Locations:  Austin or London (Hybrid)  
 About the Role
 We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.
 Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.
 This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line
 This is a rare "0-to-1" seat: you'll help define the interaction model for a suite of product categories we are largely inventing, with room to shape not just how it looks but what it fundamentally is.
 Who you are
 Note: A portfolio is not required for this role, but is a bonus. Please include a link to work that shows how you think. The interview process will dive in deeper.
 A product inventor who works in the medium of design, presenting complex problems to Enterprise customers. You've taken genuinely ambiguous, ill-defined problem spaces and defined what the product should be. You can point to work where the concept was yours.
 You've had to make a complex, high-dimensional system legible to the people who live in it, whether in security, fraud, observability, developer tools, analytics, network operations, finance, or somewhere equally demanding. You don't need a security background, but you need the mind and craft to go deep in one fast.
 You use AI fluently in your own craft, and you have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.
 You bring independent design conviction. You've originated solutions in spaces with little prior art, and you can clearly articulate why a design is right, or why you're pushing back.
 Exceptional at the full craft — defining the problem, defining the experience requirements, information architecture, and especially data visualization — with enough polish to make it real and compelling.
 Someone who wants to obsess over a domain. You want to go deep, and are excited about pushing boundaries in a complex space.
 Comfortable with a blank page. As the first design lead, you'll set your own process and build alongside your peers and engineers.

 About the Role
 TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.
 That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. 
 Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.

You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.
 This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.

 Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business  across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.

Jobs is Databricks’ built-in orchestrator, managing hundreds of millions of workloads every week with 99.95% reliability. It powers ETL, AI/ML, BI, and streaming workloads for thousands of customers. Your focus will be on evolving control-flow capabilities, authoring experiences, and observability features that allow customers to productionize workflows with best practices like source control, code promotion, and system observability.
 This role requires a deep understanding of orchestration workflows , data pipelines , and service reliability. You will work closely with engineers, designers, field teams, and customers to define the roadmap, drive adoption, and ensure Jobs is the best-in-class orchestration platform for modern data and AI teams. 
 The impact you’ll have: 
 Define strategy & roadmap: Set vision and priorities across orchestration, triggers, authoring, and observability. Translate customer needs into features and integrations that accelerate Lakeflow Jobs adoption.
 Drive metrics & observability: Define success metrics for adoption, engagement, and developer efficiency. Use data to guide roadmap decisions and refine the product experience.
 Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with global engineering, field engineering, solution architects, and external partners to deliver impactful features and integrations.
 Champion customer needs: Talk to hundreds of customers, understand their journeys, and advocate for features that reduce friction in authoring, monitoring, and orchestrating workloads.
 Own the product lifecycle: Write PRDs, release notes, and documentation, and drive launches that ensure customer and business success.
 What we look for:
 5+ yrs of experience
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science or similar field
 Experience in Product Management (inbound, outbound, cross-functional processes)
 Solid understanding of major orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect etc.)
 Technical skills understanding of data pipelines (Spark, dbt, Lakeflow Pipelines)
 Strong data analysis and operationalization skills (SQL, Python, building operational dashboards)
 About Databricks 
 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. datadog:8028422.desc:
At Datadog, we're on a mission to build the best platform in the world for engineers to understand and scale their systems, applications, and teams. We operate at high scale, enabling seamless collaboration and problem-solving among Dev, Ops, and Security teams globally for tens of thousands of companies. Our engineering culture values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity to solve hard problems the right way.
 APM at Datadog is on its way to redefine how users interact with their telemetry. We are integrating intelligence directly into troubleshooting workflows to help engineers find root causes faster, navigate complex distributed systems seamlessly, and optimize application performance with minimal cognitive load. APM provides deep visibility from end-user interactions to backend services and we are now expanding this foundation with new AI-driven insights, guidance, and automation.
 As a Senior Product Manager for APM, you will own product strategy and drive execution across Distributed Tracing, Performance Analysis, and Intelligent Troubleshooting. You will set direction for a critical area of the roadmap, work closely with senior engineering and design leadership, and influence how APM evolves across the broader observability platform. You'll be relied on to make sound, independent product judgment calls with limited oversight, mentor other product managers, and represent APM in cross-org and executive conversations.
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.
 What you will Do: 
 Own the product strategy and long-term vision for a core area of APM, grounded in deep understanding of customers, their performance challenges, telemetry workflows, and the competitive landscape
 Lead strategic conversations with design partners and key customers to uncover complex performance issues, validate product bets, and guide solutions from early prototypes through General Availability
 Define and drive delivery of the next generation of APM features with engineering and design leadership, especially agentic onboarding and the out-of-the-box experience, AI-driven troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis

 Mentor and provide guidance to other product managers, raising the bar for product craft and customer-centric thinking across the team
 Own adoption, retention, and business impact metrics for your product area, and communicate progress and strategy to senior leadership and executives
 Who you are: 
 You have +5 years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally working on a developer-focused SaaS or infrastructure product, with a track record of owning a product area end to end
 You have experience leading production-level AI projects, from conception through launch and iteration, ideally involving ML-driven insights, automated workflows, or intelligent guidance in complex systems

decagon:7d9e30a4-249b-4032-930c-4bd7bc8a.title: Senior Agent Product Manager
decagon:7d9e30a4-249b-4032-930c-4bd7bc8a.desc:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Team

When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.

Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre-sales conversation through the life of the account.

The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.

These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role.

 

About the Role

This role owns the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for Decagon's customers, serving as the primary technical and strategic owner. You earn trust with the customer's leadership team, scope a solution that solves their problems, and then build the working AI agent. You are the direct owner for each account's agents end-to-end, partnering with our Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to scale the agent in production and grow it into a core part of how the customer's company runs.

It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you have ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing forward deployed engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution.

 

In this role, you will

 - Own the technical win on Decagon's largest strategic opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers and Forward-deployed engineers to build working AI agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical buyers into signed customers.

 - Serve as the executive partner to the C-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion.

 - Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI agents in production, going deep on each customer's workflows, pain points, and goals.

 - Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap.

 - Direct Forward-deployed engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome.

 - Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments.
   
    

Your background looks something like this

 - 6+ years of experience owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward-deployed or solutions roles at high-growth technology companies.

 - A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it.

 - Strong technical acumen. You

 About the team 
 The People Technology Product team builds the internal tools and frameworks that power every employee’s journey across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. We combine a hybrid “build + buy” approach to deliver intelligent, scalable and people-centric experiences across hiring, pre-boarding, onboarding, learning, performance and more — connecting our mission to transform the way the world eats and shops with the experience of the people who make it happen. We partner closely with Design, Engineering, Analytics, People/HR and IT to build products that elevate the entire People Tech stack across all three brands.
 About the role 
 We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the product experience for pre-boarding and onboarding — one of the highest-leverage moments in the employee lifecycle — across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on the cross-functional experience that begins the moment a candidate signs and continues until a new hire is fully ramped, spanning both the People and IT functions. You’ll be the end-to-end product owner for the systems, workflows and experiences that get equipment, access, accounts, paperwork and early enablement right from day one. Based in London and working with global teams, you’ll drive measurable improvements to the new-hire experience and help our new hires ramp up faster, at scale across regions, legal contexts, and brands.
 What you'll be doing 
 Own the end-to-end product roadmap and execution for pre-boarding and onboarding across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt, from offer acceptance through to a fully ramped new hire.
 Design and evolve cross-functional experiences that connect People and IT workflows — provisioning, access and account setup, equipment, documentation and early enablement — into a single, coherent journey for new joiners and their managers.
 Define and track the metrics that matter — time-to-productivity, new-hire satisfaction, day-one readiness and operational efficiency — and use them to prioritise work and demonstrate impact.
 Build durable, modular product capabilities — task orchestration, status visibility, and manager and new-hire dashboards — that scale across geographies, orgs and brands and reduce reliance on manual, one-off processes.
 Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, People/HR and IT to translate complex, cross-functional process needs into intuitive product capabilities.
 Navigate the realities of a multi-brand, multi-region environment — varied legal and compliance requirements, regional differences and change management — without disrupting critical hiring moments.
 Set the product vision and influence senior stakeholders across the People and IT functions, building alignment on a shared onboarding strategy across all three brands.
 Model strong product judgement: define clear problem statements, scope MVPs intentionally and invest in foundations that compound over time.
 Requirements 
 A track record of building and shipping products end-to-end — from problem definition and strategy through delivery and iteration — ideally in People/HR, IT or other complex, cross-functional environments.
 Experience designing products and workflows that span multiple functions, systems and stakeholders, turning complexity into simple, usable experiences.
 Comfort working with both custom-built tools and third-party SaaS platforms, including integrating data across systems.
 Strong analytical skills and the habit of using data and metrics to define success, prioritise and measure impact.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain product decisions clearly and influence senior leaders across functions and brands.
 Experience operating across regions, legal contexts or multiple brands, building products that work in a global environment.
 A bias for delivering high-quality products in a fast-moving organisation, balancing speed, risk and technical constraints.

 Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
 We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world.  What You’ll Be Doing
 You’ll be joining the Network Efficiency team. We work at the heart of Deliveroo’s logistics engine, collaborating with Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning and Operations Research to optimise real-time predictions and dispatch decisions across all our markets.
 Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:
 Design and ship new logistics capabilities that directly improve our customer, merchant and rider propositions.
 Lead prioritisation and trade-off decisions , navigating complex marketplace dynamics and escalating to senior leadership when required.
 Own product goals from inception to delivery , collaborating across disciplines to ensure we ship high-quality, high-impact solutions.

 Translate complex ambiguity into clear execution plans , ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-leverage opportunities.
 What You’ll Need to Thrive
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
 Proven ability to solve complex problems , with a knack for asking the right questions and translating ambiguity into actionable roadmaps.
 Significant experience being data-savvy and analytical ; you can grasp technical concepts quickly and partner effectively with Machine Learning and Operations Research specialists.
 A systems-thinking mindset , with the ability to balance customer needs with commercial goals while considering second and third-order effects on the marketplace.
 Demonstrated ownership of high-velocity execution , maintaining a sharp eye for detail in an environment where impact is paramount.
 A growth mindset and the resilience to learn fast, adapt to failures, and keep moving forward.
 Why Join Us?
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

 Own high-impact growth problems end-to-end, identifying opportunities across the customer lifecycle—from acquisition and activation to retention and monetisation.
 Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Commercial to align on priorities and drive execution from concept to launch.

deliveroo:8206559.desc:
Our Global Structure 
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
 Senior Product Manager, Core People Technology
 Location: London | Work model: Hybrid | Reports to: Senior Manager, People Product
 About the team
 People Technology builds and runs the systems behind every hire, transfer, leave, pay change and offboard for our workforce across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our mission is to make the operational backbone of People Operations invisible when it works — reliable, compliant, and scalable across dozens of markets — so our people teams can focus on people, not process. This role sits on the People Product team, working alongside Business Systems Analysts, engineers and delivery leadership to bring product thinking to one of our highest-volume, highest-consequence surfaces.
 About the role
 Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. Demand structurally exceeds capacity, and requests arrive from every direction without a shared shape. You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.
 This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.
 What you'll be doing
 Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why
 Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes
 Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship
 Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work
 Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead
 Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)
 Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date
 Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short
 Requirements
 Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature
 Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations
 Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done
 Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented
 Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome
 Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions
 Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them
 Why Deliveroo 
 Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighborhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
 We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

 Introduction to the Team: 
 Expedia Group powers travel for everyone, everywhere. As AI becomes core to how travelers plan, book, and manage their trips, it is also changing how we build for them — and merchandising is where that change is furthest along. 
 The Merchandising Platform team owns the commercial layer of the traveler experience across every Expedia Group brand: price display, product badging, price insights, the algorithms that identify and rank collections, and the merchandising pages and services that power them. Today, brand teams operate this platform manually — designing individual experiments, configuring each change, and waiting weeks between an idea and a result. We are building the agentic systems that change that: autonomous agents that generate hypotheses, assemble experiences from configurable components, run experiments continuously within brand-defined guardrails, and roll out winners — with brand teams acting as strategists and governors rather than operators. 
 In this role, you will be a hands-on AI builder PM at the centre of that shift. You will prototype and ship multi-agent systems that automate the merchandising experiment lifecycle end to end, define the trust and governance patterns that let agents act safely on live traveler experiences, and lead the most promising capabilities from experiment to production at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands — and set the pattern for how autonomous optimisation expands across the rest of the traveler journey. 
 In this Role, you will: 
 Own the product direction for autonomous merchandising optimisation — from agent-assisted experiment setup today to agents that generate, launch, evaluate, and roll out tests continuously within brand-defined success metrics, guardrails, and policies. 
 Rapidly prototype agentic flows hands-on: orchestration across specialised sub-agents, tool/function calling against internal platform APIs, prompt and context design, agent memory, and evaluation harnesses — proving value and feasibility before committing engineering investment. 
 Take successful prototypes to production with engineering, data science, and design — including human review gates, guardrail breach detection, automated rollback, audit trails, and attribution so every agent action is measurable and reversible. 
 Define the trust architecture for agents acting on live experiences: preview/approve/undo flows, escalation triggers, explainability, and override tracking — patterns designed to be adopted by teams across Expedia Group as autonomous optimisation expands to new surfaces. 
 Drive measurable outcomes: compress experiment cycle time from months to days, multiply experiment throughput per surface, and demonstrate conversion and revenue lift from agent-optimised merchandising — without degrading traveler trust or experience quality. 
 Partner closely with experimentation, content and configuration platforms, GenAI platform, and brand product teams across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo to make agent capabilities work end to end across the organisation. 
 Evaluate emerging capabilities from frontier labs and internal platforms — tool use, multi-agent orchestration, agent memory, evaluation techniques — and translate them into concrete product concepts and working demos. 
 Lead the organisational shift alongside the technical one: build brand teams' trust in agent-operated optimisation, define how they set strategy and guardrails rather than individual tests, and share playbooks so agentic operation becomes how merchandising works across Expedia Group.

getyourguide:8284800.title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
getyourguide:8284800.desc:
Change the way the world travels 
 GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, people from all over the world have booked more than 150 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 1000 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.
 Team mission 
 GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.
 Your mission 
 As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.
 The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.
 We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.
 What You'll Do 
 Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.
 Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.
 Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.
 Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.
 Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.
 Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.
 Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.
 Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products
