hellofresh:8025707.title: Senior Product Manager
hellofresh:8025707.desc:
HelloFresh Ireland is in an exciting growth phase - expanding customer choice, deepening menu relevance, and driving long-term loyalty in a fast-growing market. As our Senior Product Manager, you will own the product space, driving impact across product strategy, product operations, and culinary workstreams. You will lead a talented, dedicated team and serve as the strategic engine behind what makes our boxes brilliant for Irish customers.
 This is not a technology product role. You will work across the full physical product value chain and lifecycle - from ingredient sourcing and culinary development through to menu strategy, editorial execution, and customer experience - making decisions that directly impact what lands on our customers' doorsteps every week. You will need the ability to operate at pace, cut through complexity, and bring teams and stakeholders with you.
 What You Will Be Doing: 
 Strategic business planning: Reviewing product KPIs and guiding the team to improve the product offering - balancing short-term operations with long-term strategic direction, and owning the product investment calendar to increase retention while optimising for revenue and costs.
 Stakeholder Management: Collaborating and building strong relationships with Operations, Marketing, and international teams - being the voice of the physical product for HelloFresh Ireland, advising on coherent processes between functions, and ensuring a coordinated approach to product initiatives across local and global stakeholders.
 Process optimisation: Identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve how we work - across teams and with key partners - and aligning operational improvements with the strategic direction.
 Analytical decision making: Working with the team to ensure access to the relevant information, analyses, and insights needed to make informed product development decisions and translate the product vision into action.
 Business case development: Developing business cases around physical product improvements and product-related processes (e.g. changes in product offering, tooling, and automations), and making data-led recommendations to Ireland and global teams.
 People management: Leading, developing and inspiring teams spanning Culinary, Physical Product Strategy, and Product Operations - setting clear strategic direction, cultivating a high-performing culture, and supporting each team member's growth across different career stages.
 Who You Are: 
 Senior experience in product, category, or commercial - ideally food, FMCG, meal kits, or subscription.
 A genuine passion for food, with the ability to translate taste trends and market signals into compelling product offerings.
 Proven people leadership across different career stages - coaching, clear direction, and investment in growth.
 Strong commercial acumen - connecting product decisions to business outcomes including revenue and retention.
 Excellent cross-functional influence - aligning teams toward a shared goal without needing formal authority.
 Organised and structured, with strong project management skills and the ability to deliver to tight deadlines.
 Strong analytical skills - able to drill into detail, connect findings to the big picture, and present insights clearly.
 Customer-centric, with creative thinking to identify unmet needs and develop solutions that address them.
 A bias for action - moving quickly without sacrificing quality, bringing momentum to the teams around you.
 Sharp problem-solving instincts - comfortable with ambiguity and confident driving toward solutions.
 At home in lean, agile environments - able to do more with less and build from the ground up.
 Comfortable in Excel and Google Suite.
 Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
 What you will get in return: 
 The chance to have a serious impact on one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Europe in an exciting growth phase
 Direct, high impact on our Operations setup from day one
 A vibrant, international environment with mission-driven colleagues
 A guaranteed steep learning curve & boost for your career
 Benefit from our selection of employee perks (70% off your HelloFresh boxes, private health insurance, employer matching pension program, cycle to work scheme, Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme, gym membership etc.)
 Location : Dublin Docklands, Ireland
 To be considered for this role, you’ll need to have the independent right to work in ROI, as we're unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship at this time. 
 Hybrid Working Policy 
We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies

hellofresh:8043204.title: Staff Product Manager, Benefits Platform (all genders)
hellofresh:8043204.desc:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month. Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.
 About the role: What's in the Box 
 As a Staff Product Manager, you will own and evolve HelloFresh's benefit creation platform, which defines, configures, and governs every discount, voucher, and reward across all our global brands and channels. Leading a dedicated squad of engineers, you will transform this high-impact system into a flexible, scalable, and highly automated platform. This is a foundational infrastructure role where you will design self-serve tooling and robust governance rules, ensuring our marketing and commercial teams can safely launch campaigns without engineering bottlenecks. Your work will directly protect our P&L margins while unlocking innovative, automated capabilities for future customer experiences.
 What you’ll do: The Recipe 
 Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for our global benefit and incentive platform, setting the path toward intelligent, automated creation tools.
 Design scalable platform primitives and reusable building blocks to eliminate custom, one-off engineering for individual marketing campaigns.
 Establish automated governance layers, including margin floors and stacking checks, to systematically protect business profitability.
 Build intuitive back-office tooling that enables commercial and growth teams to configure standard campaigns independently.
 Drive cross-functional alignment across international teams, encouraging adoption of a unified platform contract.
 Evaluate and implement automation and smart interfaces where they bring the highest return on investment, balancing flexibility with system reliability.
 What you’ll bring: The Ingredients  
 Extensive experience in platform product management is essential, with a proven track record of building scalable internal tools, APIs, or foundational infrastructure rather than just user-facing features.
 You bring 6+ years of product management experience, specifically operating already at a Senior or Staff level within complex systems across multiple markets or diverse business lines.
 Exceptional leadership and communication skills are required to align senior, cross-functional stakeholders and champion platform adoption without direct authority.
 It is a strong advantage if you bring a background in commercial strategy or promotional economics, enabling you to design smart business guardrails that balance marketing flexibility with P&L protection.
 Familiarity with data analysis and technical architecture is highly valued, helping you effectively design reliable automation and interpret experiment data alongside engineering teams.
 Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
 What we offer: The Toppings 
 Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.
 Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.
 Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.
 End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.
 Access to workspace at Warsaw Centre Point (Prosta 20). The hub offers modern facilities including showers, breakout zones, outdoor space, cycle parking, and refreshments (coffee, soft drinks, and fruit).
 Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you.  We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

hellofresh:8095957.desc:
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.
 Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.
 HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.
 About the role: What's in the Box 
 The Foundations Alliance's mission is to accelerate the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and highly available digital products at HelloFresh by providing services and platforms that improve internal builder productivity and system reliability. This position is for a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the Operational Data Platform—the systems that create, transport, and store data at the point of origin, making it available for downstream analytics or AI. The role holds accountability for a high-leverage layer of the data ecosystem: the streaming and database infrastructure that product engineering teams rely on to get data flowing reliably.
The core objective is to ensure operational data is created, delivered, and shared downstream reliably, cost-efficiently, and with explicit quality guarantees. The service provider will define the roadmap for the squad's platform (event streaming, relational, and NoSQL databases), partner closely with the Engineering Lead for the Operational Data Platform, and collaborate cross-functionally with data producer and analytical teams. This engagement comes at a key moment for critical-path cost-efficiency and reliability initiatives. This role does not include people management responsibilities.
 At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.
 What you’ll do: The Recipe 
 Drive the product vision and roadmap for the Operational Data Platform—focusing on low-latency data creation, transport, storage, and availability for downstream analytics—partnering closely with the Engineering Lead for the platform.
 Lead the squad's cost-efficiency roadmap , taking accountability for targeted cost savings as a core KPI.
 Maintain the reliability of critical-path systems (streaming and core databases), setting uptime targets and feeding incident learnings back into platform planning.
 Champion data-contract and schema standards at the point of data creation, collaborating with data-producing engineering teams to close adoption gaps and ensure quality data flows downstream.
 Guide platform tooling decisions , consolidating technologies around optimal solutions rather than accumulating redundant options.
 Define and maintain the handover contract with the Analytical Data Platform, ensuring downstream data is consistently trustworthy and ready for governance.
 Act as the primary interface between the Operational Data Platform and data producers, translating business and technical needs into actionable roadmap priorities.
 Define, track, and report squad KPIs (cost efficiency, critical-path reliability, data-quality adoption) against quarterly alliance goals.
 What you’ll bring: The Ingredients  
 Proven experience as a Product Manager with a solid grounding in data infrastructure, data engineering, or backend platforms—comfortable with streaming, messaging, and database architecture.
 Working familiarity with event streaming and relational/NoSQL database technologies to partner credibly with engineering leads on technical trade-offs.
 Track record of driving roadmaps and KPIs for technical teams in platform problem spaces, managing metrics like cost, reliability, or data quality to target.
 Data-driven approach to prioritization and roadmap decisions, supported by analytical tools and frameworks.
 Strong collaboration and communication capabilities to establish trust and technical alignment with engineering leads and key stakeholders.
 Pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset to drive day-to-day delivery autonomously and navigate cost, reliability, and technic

 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
 About The Role
 The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.
We're looking for a Head of Product to rethink our products and fraud systems to be AI-centric. You'll leverage AI for automation and enable intuitive, multi-modal customer interactions to build trust and streamline compliance processes.

AlumnForce est une plateforme SaaS qui aide les écoles, universités, associations et entreprises à animer leurs communautés d’alumni : réseau, carrière, mentoring, événements, communication et fundraising.
 Aujourd’hui, plus de 300 réseaux dans 15 pays utilisent AlumnForce, représentant plusieurs millions de membres.
 Nous sommes une trentaine de personnes, avec une équipe Produit & Tech resserrée et un produit web + mobile B2B2C : utilisé quotidiennement par les équipes qui administrent les communautés et par leurs membres.
 Notre plateforme stocke beaucoup de données. Notre ambition pour 2027 est qu’elle soit capable d’agir intelligemment dessus. 
 Notre Cap 2027 repose notamment sur trois piliers :
 Données fiables → moteurs Workflow & Agent IA → valeur métier mesurable == gain de temps des animateurs de communauté et impact sur les membres 
 Concrètement, cela doit se traduire par :
 du temps gagné pour les administrateurs de communauté grâce à l’automatisation
 des échanges plus pertinents avec les membres grâce à une meilleure connaissance de leurs profils, besoins et attentes
 un impact mesurable pour les responsables qui doivent démontrer la valeur du réseau auprès de leur direction
 Nous travaillons sur des sujets comme :
 qualification, enrichissement et normalisation des données ;
 agents IA capables d’utiliser les données et fonctionnalités AlumnForce ;
 recherche et segmentation conversationnelles ;
 dashboards et indicateurs permettant de mesurer l’impact d’un réseau ;
 ouverture contrôlée de la plateforme aux assistants IA de nos clients via MCP ;
 automatisations permettant de déclencher des actions à partir de la donnée.
 Nous recherchons un·e Senior Product Manager Data & AI capable de transformer ces ambitions en produits réellement utilisés, mesurables et monétisables.
 Tu travailleras en parallèle avec un Product Manager orienté Design UI/UX, particulièrement impliqué sur l’expérience utilisateur, les parcours, le prototypage et la simplification des interfaces complexes.
 Tes missions : 
 Transformer notre donnée en produit Une base alumni évolue en permanence : changements d’entreprise ou de métier, données incomplètes, doublons, informations obsolètes ou difficilement comparables entre réseaux.
 Notre ambition est progressivement de construire une base qui s’améliore plutôt que de simplement stocker ce qu’on lui donne .

Senior Product Manager, Cluster Scalability
 Location: Dublin
 About the Role
 MongoDB is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own scalability for the Atlas data platform. Atlas is how the world’s most demanding applications run on MongoDB — from real-time gaming and financial transactions to AI workloads with unpredictable traffic patterns. When those applications grow, slow down, spike, or contract, scalability is the layer that decides whether the customer trusts us to keep running their business.
 This role owns the end-to-end product experience for how customers scale up, scale down, and horizontally scale their Atlas deployments. That includes vertical scaling (instance tier changes), autoscaling, horizontal scaling (sharding and shard key strategy), and the operational workflows around all of them. You will set the strategy, drive execution with engineering, and be accountable for measurable year-over-year improvements in how reliably and predictably customers scale.
 We care less about whether you’ve worked on databases before and more about whether you’re the kind of PM who can ramp fast on a hard technical domain, form a clear opinion about what needs to happen, and defend that opinion to senior engineers, field partners, and enterprise CTOs, especially when they disagree with you. Database and scaling concepts are teachable. Judgment, conviction, and crispness are not.
 Responsibilities
       Set a clear, opinionated vision and strategy for Atlas cluster scalability and translate it into concrete, prioritized bets each release.
       Own the end-to-end roadmap for vertical scaling, autoscaling, and horizontal scaling, including the operational and observability surfaces customers rely on during scaling events.
       Make hard prioritization calls, including saying no to things with real customer or leadership support, and own those decisions and their consequences.
       Build deep technical understanding of Atlas scaling internals (instance tier mechanics, autoscaler logic, sharding, balancer behavior, capacity headroom) and use it to shape requirements and tradeoffs with engineering. You don’t need to know this on day one. You do need to know it deeply by month two.
       Represent product direction with conviction to senior engineering leaders, field partners, and enterprise customers, especially when they disagree.
       Stay close to customers and field partners to deeply understand scaling pain points, failure patterns, and the moments where trust is won or lost.
       Define success metrics for scalability, build analytics that surface issues early, and use data to inform clear, timely decisions under ambiguity.
       Lead proactive, cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Docs, Support, Marketing, and Sales to ship reliable, high-quality scaling experiences and accelerate adoption.
       Mentor junior PMs, contribute to strategic product thinking across teams, and influence leadership-level product decisions, all while operating without direct reports.
       Be accountable to year-over-year growth on the metrics that matter for Atlas scalability.
 Requirements
 Required qualifications
       5+ years of product management experience on technically complex, infrastructure-level products. Database, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure experience is a plus but not required. We care about your ability to ramp fast on hard technical domains and make sound product decisions once you do.
       Demonstrated success owning enterprise-grade, technical products end-to-end — not just shipping them, but delivering measurable customer and business outcomes you can quantify.
       Technical fluency: comfortable discussing architecture, failure modes, performance characteristics, and tradeoffs with senior engineers, and connecting technical decisions directly to customer outcomes. You don’t need to know what an autoscaler does on day one. You do need to be the kind of PM who will understand it deeply within your first month and have an opinion about how it affects the customer experience by month two.
       Track record of taking products from 0 to 1 and from 1 to 50 — building something new and scaling what works.
       Strong customer-orientation and field-connection, regularly engaging directly with customers and field teams and translating their input into clear requirements and roadmap decisions.
       Excellent written and verbal communication: crisp, high-quality artifacts and the ability to tailor the message by audience (engineering, executives, customers, field). In this role you will represent product direction to enterprise CTOs and to senior engineering leaders who may disagree with your priorities. You need to hold the room.
       Strong analytical skills and metrics rigor, including defining success metrics, instrumenting and debugging analytics, and using data to inform (but not replace) judgment.
       Demonstrated decision-making speed and conviction

monzo:8156058.desc:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 
 We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
 After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as  personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and  combine their pensions with us. 
 With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
 We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
 📍London - Hybrid | 💰£125,000 - £145,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits   ✨
 Our Payments team⭐
 Payments is at the heart of Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.
 This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.

 🔑You’ll play a key role by...

 Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.
 Moving the team from reactive delivery towards a more strategic, product-led approach, asking why we’re building things, what good looks like, and how today’s choices support Monzo’s long-term needs.
 Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.
 Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.
 Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.
 Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.
 Bringing strong product discipline, technical curiosity and systems thinking to a space that is critical to Monzo’s future growth.

 You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.
 You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.
 You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.
 You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.
 You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.

Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

 💰 £125,000 - £145,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance ➕ equity

n26:8267143.title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
n26:8267143.desc:
About the opportunity
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.
 Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.
 In this role, you will 
 Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
 Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
 Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
 Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
 Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
 Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.
 What you need to be successful 
 Background & Experience 
 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
 High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
 Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.
 Technical & Domain Skills 
 Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
 Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
 Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
 Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.
 Traits 
 Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
 Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
 Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.
 What’s in it for you 
 Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.
 Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
 A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for fri

ABOUT PARLOA

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com,  HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.


ABOUT PARLOA

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com http://booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale. 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Infrastructure Platform team owns the foundation that every other engineering team at Parloa builds on: cloud infrastructure, provisioning and orchestration, CI/CD, and the runtime environments that our AI agents execute in. Its current flagship initiative, Deployment Stamps, is re-platforming how Parloa delivers isolated, reliable, and compliant environments across public cloud and customer-owned private cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

We are looking for a Staff or Principal Product Manager to own the product management for this team. This is one of the most technical product roles at Parloa. You will not be writing user stories for a UI, you will be shaping the architecture-adjacent product strategy for a platform whose "customers" are largely internal engineering teams and the most demanding enterprise security, compliance, and infrastructure stakeholders on the other side of the table.

This is a builder role in a domain where the playbook is still being written. If you want to define what "good" looks like for enterprise-grade AI infrastructure, data residency and sovereignty, isolation, and a multi-cloud operating model, and you are energized by deeply technical problems and technical stakeholders, this is it.

A note on background: We have a strong preference for candidates who have spent time as an Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, or senior engineer before moving into product. This domain rewards genuine technical depth and the instinct to earn trust with engineers by speaking their language. A former EM who has since developed strong product judgment is exactly the profile we have in mind.

 


AREAS OF OWNERSHIP:

 - Own the Infrastructure Platform product strategy and roadmap: translating reliability, isolation, data-residency, and multi-cloud goals into a sequenced, outcomes-driven plan that engineering can execute against.

 - Be the voice of internal and enterprise customers: your primary users are Parloa engineering teams (developer experience, deployment, runtime) and your most demanding external stakeholders are enterprise CISOs, CIOs, and infrastructure leaders with strict compliance and sovereignty requirements.

 - Drive discovery and write the PRDs that frame outcomes (isolation, compliance, availability) without over-prescribing implementation, then partner with engineering leads and architects to pressure-test feasibility and trade-offs.

 - Own the hard prioritization calls: balancing near-term delivery milestones against longer-term architecture evolution, and making explicit, defensible decisions about scope, sequencing, and risk.

 - Define and track the metrics that matter for a platform: availability and SLA attainment, provisioning lead time, deployment frequency, change-failure rate, adoption by internal teams, and developer satisfaction.

 - Establish mechanisms, not just features: repeatable processes for region readiness/certification, release management, and cross-team alignment that scale as the platform grows from a handful of environments to many.

 - Align a broad, technical stakeholder set: Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal/Compliance, and the customer-facing teams (Deployment, Sales Engineering) who need to position the platform's capabilities to enterprise accounts.

 - Connect the platform to revenue: articulate how infrastructure capabilities (e.g., data residency, private cloud, isolation tiers) unlock enterprise deals, new regions, and expansion, and feed that back into prioritization.

 - Communicate clearly across technical and business contexts: equally comfortable in an architecture review and in a leadership readout.

 


WHO YOU ARE:

 - A technical-leadership background. 7+ years of combined engineering and product experience for Staff (L4); 10+ years with demonstrated product leaders

The Company 
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 
 We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 
 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
 Job Summary: 
This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. Gathering customer experience insights to inform product requirements and analyzing research, market data, and usability studies for data-driven decision-making. Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.

The Company 
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 
 We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 
 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

 Job Category 
Product 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who's eager to help transform how Salesforce and its customers work by turning cutting-edge technology capabilities into real-world solutions. This role is about applying emerging technologies to solve customer problems, drive experimentation, and deliver products that people love. You'll work side-by-side with senior product leaders and a small, fast-moving team that thrives on rapid iteration and bold ideas. We ship production-ready MVPs in months, not years, and we measure success by the impact we create for customers (both internal and external).
Emerging Technology operates like an innovation lab inside Salesforce — taking smart risks, testing new ideas quickly, and building experiences that shape the future of how we work. You'll gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies, work closely with a variety of teams across the company, and have the freedom to explore and bring fresh ideas to life. If you're excited to build with next-generation technology and grow your product career in a high-visibility environment, we want to talk to you.
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Collaborate with the product, design and engineering teams to define requirements, prioritize features, and drive execution of innovative technology experiences
 Translate complex customer problems into simple, elegant solutions that deliver measurable value to our end users
 Participate in rapid prototyping and experimentation cycles, learning to validate concepts with data, insights, and customer feedback
 Work across product, design, engineering, and operations to deliver solutions on tight timelines
 Engage directly with customers and early adopters to test ideas, gather feedback, and uncover new opportunities
 Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies, bringing fresh perspectives and ideas to the team
 Contribute to product roadmaps, write crisp product requirements, and track success metrics
 What We're Looking For 
 Required Qualifications
 7+ years of experience in product management or a related role (software engineering, design, or strategy experience a plus)
 Familiarity with emerging technologies, data-driven products, or innovative technology platforms (direct experience with cutting-edge tools or technologies is a strong plus, but not required)
 Proven ability to drive execution: translating ideas into features we can ship and iterating based on results
 Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders
 Customer-first mindset, with experience gathering insights and turning them into product decisions
 Curiosity, adaptability, and comfort with ambiguity as priorities shift and the work evolves
 Preferred Qualifications
 Advanced degree in a technical or analytical discipline
 Prior experience working in an early-stage, 0-to-1 product environment
 Background in emerging or experimental technology spaces (AI, spatial computing, enterprise tools, etc.)
 Experience with customer-facing tools and user interface design
 Why Join? 
 You'll get hands-on exposure to technologies that haven't hit the mainstream yet, direct access to senior product leaders, and the freedom to shape a roadmap rather than just execute one. This is a high-visibility team where the distance between an idea and a shipped product is short.
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

 As Salesforce continues to expand its operational footprint globally, we need a strong product and program leader to drive the technology and process work that lets us stand up and support employees in new countries and regions. This role sits at the intersection of geo-expansion initiatives and the broader HR technology stack (Workday and adjacent systems), ensuring that as the business enters new markets, our people systems and processes scale with it. In addition to Geo Expansion product responsibilities, this role will also support the product team for Total Rewards and HR Operations, partnering closely with those Centers of Excellence (COEs) on their technology and process needs.
 This is a highly cross-functional role — you'll partner with stakeholders across HR, IT, Legal, Finance, Global Mobility, and regional business teams to translate expansion requirements into scoped, deliverable technology and process solutions. While geo-expansion will be a primary focus, you may also flex into other HR/IT product and program initiatives — including Total Rewards and HR Operations — as priorities shift.
 What You'll Do
 Own end-to-end product and program management for geo-expansion initiatives — from intake and requirements gathering through delivery and post-launch support.
 Partner with Workday and other HR technology teams to configure, extend, or integrate systems needed to support employees in new countries (payroll, benefits, compliance, local policy configuration, etc.).
 Translate business and legal/compliance requirements for new country entities into clear product requirements and program plans.
 Build and manage cross-functional program plans, timelines, and RAID logs spanning multiple teams inside and outside HR/IT.
 Act as the primary point of coordination between HR/IT and external stakeholders (Legal, Finance, Global Mobility, regional HR/business leads) on expansion-related work.
 Identify risks, dependencies, and process gaps early, and drive mitigation plans across stakeholder groups.
 Define success metrics and reporting to track expansion program health and technology adoption.
 Continuously improve the playbook/framework for launching new countries, so each expansion becomes faster and more repeatable.
 Support the product team for Total Rewards and HR Operations, bringing product/program rigor to their initiatives and roadmaps.
 Support other HR/IT product or program initiatives as capacity allows and priorities evolve.
 What You'll Bring
 Strong product management fundamentals: requirements gathering, prioritization, roadmap development, and stakeholder alignment.
 Strong program management fundamentals: planning, cross-team coordination, risk management, and executive-ready status reporting.
 Strong hands-on Workday experience (e.g., HCM, Core Compensation, Benefits, or related modules), with comfort learning and navigating the broader HR tech ecosystem.
 Demonstrated ability to work across a wide and varied stakeholder group, including senior stakeholders inside and outside of HR/IT.
 Experience with global/international programs — geo-expansion, market entry, or multi-country HR operations is a strong plus.
 Experience supporting Total Rewards and/or HR Operations COEs — in a Product, IT, or HR practitioner capacity — is a plus.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to synthesize complexity into clear, actionable plans.
 Comfortable operating with ambiguity and shifting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
 Self-starter who can drive work independently without a team of direct reports.
 Minimum Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 7+ years of relevant experience in product management, program management, HRIS/HR technology, or a related field.
 Demonstrated hands-on experience with Workday or a comparable core HR technology platform.
 Proven experience managing cross-functional programs with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
 Experience working within highly complex, large global organizations, navigating multi-region, multi-stakeholder environments at scale.
 Experience operating independently as

sierra:2e07f536-bbaa-4cc0-957a-774ddf99d.title: Product Manager, Agent Development (Italian speaking)
sierra:2e07f536-bbaa-4cc0-957a-774ddf99d.desc:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build Enterprise-grade AI Agents: As an Agent PM at Sierra, you will be responsible for partnering directly with our engineers and customers to build and ship AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day.

 - Engage with Customers: In the role, you will engage with all levels of our customers’ businesses:
   
   - Discover and assess their requirements.
   
   - Prepare and present demonstrations of Sierra’s agent.
   
   - Address and overcome technical challenges in the business process by working with technical counterparts.
   
   - Develop and improve Sierra virtual agents to fit and anticipate our customers’ needs and business processes.
   
   - Become trusted advisors and drive strategic technical strategies for our customers.

 - Shape the Product Roadmap: Work with Sierra’s engineering and product development teams to scope and implement new features essential to the success of your customers.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5-7+ years experience in product development of highly technical products.

 - Past experience in Product Management or other similar product development roles at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.

 - Experience crafting and tailoring a message for potential customers, including executives.

 - Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent AI developments.

 - Degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.


EVEN BETTER...

 - AI-related experience (experience with product development for AI agents a plus).

 - Some coding experience with React, Typescript, and Go.

 - MBA or equivalent professional experience (while this is a product management role, you will have the opportunity to lean into broader business roles).

 - Past roles that interface with end customers to influence software development.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family bui

sierra:4892f01e-8871-4b32-8963-527f1cf8d.desc:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build Enterprise-grade AI Agents: As an Agent PM at Sierra, you will be responsible for partnering directly with our engineers and customers to build and ship AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day.

 - Engage with Customers: In the role, you will engage with all levels of our customers’ businesses:
   
   - Discover and assess their requirements.
   
   - Prepare and present demonstrations of Sierra’s agent.
   
   - Address and overcome technical challenges in the business process by working with technical counterparts.
   
   - Develop and improve Sierra virtual agents to fit and anticipate our customers’ needs and business processes.
   
   - Become trusted advisors and drive strategic technical strategies for our customers.

 - Shape the Product Roadmap: Work with Sierra’s engineering and product development teams to scope and implement new features essential to the success of your customers.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5-7+ years experience in product development of highly technical products.

 - Past experience in Product Management or other similar product development roles at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.

 - Experience crafting and tailoring a message for potential customers, including executives.

 - Ability to communicate highly technical concepts to both non-technical and technically proficient audiences, including recent AI developments.

 -  Professional fluency in both Spanish and English.

 - Degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.


EVEN BETTER...

 - AI-related experience (experience with product development for AI agents a plus).

 - Some coding experience with React, Typescript, and Go.

 - MBA or equivalent professional experience (while this is a product management role, you will have the opportunity to lean into broader business roles).

 - Past roles that interface with end customers to influence software development.


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of emp
