spotify:080868dd-fc8c-4648-b6ab-6780d8ca.title: Principal Product Manager - Audio and Media Playback
spotify:080868dd-fc8c-4648-b6ab-6780d8ca.desc:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We are looking for a Principal Product Manager who will join the Play Product Area within the Core Experience Studio to help evolve the experience of audio and media playback on Spotify. You will help define and evolve the experiences that make playing on Spotify more engaging, rewarding, and valuable for users, creators, and Spotify. Above all, your work will impact how hundreds of millions users experience music and media.

What You'll Do
Work with a cross-functional team that looks after our audio playback capabilities
 Work with engineering, design, data science and user research to ensure the experience is scalable, usable, and useful for a range of strategies
 Lead multiple projects across the entire product lifecycle
 Triangulate data and insights to develop a robust product strategy and inform decision-making as well as short- and long-term roadmaps
 Manage cross-functional and cross-org relationships to keep teams and leaders informed, receive input, and influence their thinking
Who You Are
You are an experienced product manager with the ability to work with cross-functional teams, lead complex projects across multiple strategies and stakeholders, and make data-driven decisions
 You are an expert in audio experiences, with a strong understanding of both the engineering aspects of audio processing and editing, as well as their impact on the user listening experience. For example, you understand how features like crossfading and beatmatching influence the flow and feel of an audio session, while also ensuring high overall audio quality
 Experience from developing video playback experiences (in addition to audio) is a plus; e.g. low-latency video delivery, DRM, and optimizing playback for improved QoE
 You have led the product work of several products in large tech companies that you can tell us about
 You have a deep understanding of product practices and know how to incorporate multiple different perspectives (including user research, data and strategy) into one single product vision and experience
 You care about creating engaging, rewarding, and valuable experiences for users, creators, and Spotify
Where You'll Be
This role is based in Stockholm or London.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

spotify:7f0a8faa-f4f5-4db9-9f51-4101d6a2.title: Product Manager - Customer Service Platform
spotify:7f0a8faa-f4f5-4db9-9f51-4101d6a2.desc:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.
Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale.
You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.
 

What You'll Do
Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users.
 Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time.
 Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales.
 Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
 Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience.
 Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users.
 Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.
Who You Are
You have 4+ years of product management experience and a track record of delivering impactful products in technology-driven environments.
 You think in systems and understand how APIs, integrations, platforms, and tooling can work together to create leverage across an organisation.
 You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on API design, system architecture, and technical trade-offs; you don't need to write code, but you can engage confidently in technical conversations.
 You know how to take products from discovery through delivery, balancing thoughtful product development with the pace needed to learn and make progress.
 You are curious about customer service and support operations and bring empathy for both the people providing support and the users receiving it.
 You communicate clearly, can make complex trade-offs understandable, and know how to create alignment across technical and non-technical partners.
 You use data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgement to make decisions and are comfortable adapting when you learn something new.
 You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines and care about building products that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the people who support them.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London, UK.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

spotify:a57db22d-dc0d-4f36-9a2e-34acdf1e.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions (Premium Desirability)
spotify:a57db22d-dc0d-4f36-9a2e-34acdf1e.desc:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.
This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

What You Will Do
Own the product strategy and roadmap for Premium awareness, acquisition, and activation, helping more listeners discover its value and take the next step toward subscribing.
 Lead the discovery, development, and launch of consumer-facing product experiences, from early ideas and testing through to global rollout.
 Shape how people experience Premium across Spotify and partner channels, creating engaging journeys that build consideration, encourage subscription, and support long-term retention.
 Collaborate with partnerships and commercial teams to develop, launch, and scale subscription offerings across partners, markets, and audience segments.
 Lead experimentation to understand what drives interest in Premium, using A/B testing and behavioral insights to improve the user journey and measure business impact.
 Turn customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear product opportunities, measurable goals, and informed priorities.
 Balance user needs, business outcomes, partner requirements, and regional differences to make thoughtful product decisions that deliver sustainable growth.
 Bring teams together around a shared direction, communicating product strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.
Where You'll Be
You have a strong track record in product management, building and launching consumer-facing products at scale, with experience in areas such as subscriptions, consumer growth, marketplaces, media, or partner ecosystems.
 You understand what makes a product valuable to consumers and how product experiences, positioning, and messaging influence consideration and willingness to pay.
 You know how to identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and retention, and connect product decisions to subscriber and revenue growth.
 You're confident designing experiments, interpreting A/B tests, and using funnel, cohort, and behavioral data to make informed product decisions.
 You have experience working across different markets and customer segments, balancing globally consistent experiences with local needs and opportunities.
 You bring sound product judgment, knowing when to improve an existing experience, explore a new approach, or invest in longer-term capabilities.
 You're a thoughtful communicator and collaborative partner who can bring together diverse perspectives, influence decisions, and align cross-functional teams around shared goals.
 You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing assumptions, learning from outcomes, and adapting your approach as new insights emerge.
Where You Will Be
This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

spotify:ddc10181-6ecc-4dfc-9d02-2c5ce820.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer - Audiobooks
spotify:ddc10181-6ecc-4dfc-9d02-2c5ce820.desc:
We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented Senior Product Manager to join the Books Vertical and lead end-to-end book experiences on Spotify: from discovery and conversion through to listening, and from the creator pipeline through to the consumer shelf. This role is about connecting the dots across our core experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling to make books work seamlessly on Spotify.
Books are a major focus for Spotify, and we need someone who can look holistically across the book ecosystem to identify gaps, reduce friction, and make sure our experiences are coherent end-to-end. You'll focus on making the full books journey work better for listeners, creators, and rights-holders, not just shipping new features. You'll partner closely with Personalization, Subscriptions, Experience, and creator-facing teams to strengthen and evolve book experiences across surfaces, and help shape a product strategy that directly improves how listeners discover and enjoy books.

What You'll Do 
Shape and execute product strategy across core book experiences, conversion flows, content pipeline, and creator tooling.
 Partner with teams across Spotify to identify and close gaps across book surfaces, creating a coherent end-to-end experience from content pipeline through to the consumer experience.
 Collaborate with Design, Engineering, Product Insights, and Program Management to lead improvements across discovery, conversion, listening, and creator-facing surfaces.
 Conduct, commission, and use research to understand listener behavior, creator needs, book consumption patterns, and market trends.
 Use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify the most impactful opportunities across the book ecosystem and prioritize accordingly.
 Define and track success metrics across the book experience, connecting upstream pipeline health with downstream listener outcomes.
 Identify systemic friction points and opportunities across the book ecosystem, and advocate for improvements that strengthen the end-to-end experience.
Who You Are
You have 4+ years of experience in product management, ideally working across complex product ecosystems with multiple surfaces, partners, and dependencies.
 You have a track record of improving multi-surface product experiences, not just launching new features but making existing systems work better together.
 You use analytics, A/B testing, and user research to guide product decisions.
 You're comfortable working across both consumer-facing and platform or tooling surfaces, and can move between listener needs and creator needs.
 You communicate clearly and build shared understanding across teams that don't always see each other's work, translating between consumer, pipeline, and creator perspectives.
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and managing complexity across multiple teams and partners.
 You think in systems and map how changes in one part of the ecosystem (content pipeline, creator tooling, conversion flows, consumer surfaces) affect the rest.
 You look for the most impactful fix rather than optimizing surfaces in isolation.
Where You'll Be
This role is based in London or Stockholm
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

spotify:e74bfb24-55de-4d93-b228-ae38b8fd.title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
spotify:e74bfb24-55de-4d93-b228-ae38b8fd.desc:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do
Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
 Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
 Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
 Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
 Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
 Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
 Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.
Who You Are
You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
 You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
 You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
 You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
 You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
 You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
 You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
 You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
 You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.

The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

User Platform builds the identity and access capabilities that help people use Spotify safely and easily. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how people access Spotify and stay connected across our apps, devices, and strategic partner integrations. You’ll focus on session management - how Spotify recognizes someone after they sign in, maintains their access, and enables them to connect or disconnect devices and applications.

You’ll bring together consumer experience and technical product strategy, working closely with engineering, design, research, insights, security, and teams responsible for Spotify’s clients and partnerships. What You'll Do

stripe:8041655.title: Product Manager, E-Invoicing
stripe:8041655.desc:
About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy.
 About the role 
 Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.
 We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.
 This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market.
 What you'll do 
 Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent multi-year strategy
 Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines
 Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality
 Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol
 Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature
 Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement
 Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers
 Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks
 Who you are 
 Required 
 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain
 Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America
 Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture
 Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions
 Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs
 Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority
 Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences
 Nice to have 
 Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform
 Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products
 Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF)
 Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts
 Why this role, why now 
 E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. You'll have the mandate, the resources, and the cross-functional backing to build something significant — and the chance to make Stripe synonymous with world-class e-invoicing.

 The Stripe Issuing team enables users–from the most promising startups and largest platforms in the world to Stripe itself—to build and launch successful card programs and financial features into their product using powerful programmatic APIs and intuitive UIs. The team creates the infrastructure, user facing experiences, and partner integrations needed to manage the lifecycle of a card and enable efficient money movement. This is a great opportunity to help build one of Stripe’s fastest growing businesses. Our top users span fintechs to large enterprises & cover a range of verticals including Buy Now Pay Later, vertical SaaS platforms, on-demand marketplaces, expense management platforms, fleet, travel & more across the world.
 What you’ll do
 As EMEA Staff Product Manager for Stripe Issuing, you will lead our product development efforts for building the best-in-class card issuance systems, including designing user-facing APIs and interfaces and working directly with top global users in building and growing their card programs in EMEA. This is a highly complex and challenging role that will require you to deeply understand user needs and collaborate across internal and partner teams to build and launch a seamless product experience at scale.
 We’re looking for a strong Staff Product Manager that can run Stripe Issuing in EMEA like a standalone business, with expertise in partnering with go-to-market teams to scale our EMEA Issuing business. This Staff Product Manager will spend significant time with users to deeply understand their needs and experiences, Stripe leadership and go-to-market teams to build the EMEA Issuing strategy and roadmap, and cross-functional internal stakeholders to build compliant and scalable products.
 Responsibilities
 Lead our Stripe Issuing effort in UK and Europe
 Shape the direction and product strategy for helping users manage their card programs
 Partner with engineering to bring new Stripe Issuing product solutions to the UK and European markets
 Collaborate with other Stripe teams (design, legal, risk, compliance, engineering, etc.) early in the product development lifecycle and jointly shape product plans that lead with delightful and helpful user experiences
 Own the roadmap and go-to-market, with product marketing, of EMEA Stripe Issuing
 Act as the voice of the user in product and API designs, gathering direct feedback from customers
 Ensure we’re building in a scalable, performant way
 Who you are
 We're looking for someone who:
 Brings 8+ years of experience in a product role
 Has domain knowledge in financial products, particularly card issuing, financial systems, and card networks
 Strong focus on scaling products in close collaboration with go-to-market teams
 Has experience building platform and/or API products
 Has strong written and verbal communication skills with a talent for precise articulations of customer problems
 Can put themselves in the shoes of their users and be a steward of crafting great experiences

stripe:8124304.title: Staff Product Manager, Stripe Tax
stripe:8124304.desc:
Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for the internet. Millions of businesses use Stripe to accept payments, manage revenue, and grow globally. Stripe Tax helps businesses calculate, collect, and manage indirect taxes as they sell across products, markets, and business models.
 We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to help shape the future of Stripe Tax. In this role, you will lead high-impact product strategy and execution across a broad portfolio, making it easier for businesses to understand, calculate, collect, and manage tax as they grow.
 What you’ll do 
 As a Staff Product Manager on Stripe Tax, you will identify the most important opportunities to improve our tax products and turn them into focused strategies, durable platforms, and exceptional user experiences.
 You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Tax, Partnerships, Go-to-Market, and other product teams to:
 Set strategy and lead product initiatives that help more businesses successfully adopt and use Stripe Tax.
 Improve the speed, accuracy, reliability, and usability of Stripe Tax calculations and related workflows.
 Expand support for the geographies, tax requirements, industries, products, and business models that matter most to Stripe users.
 Build capabilities for complex tax needs, such as registrations, exemptions, address and fulfillment logic, tax customization, and other business-specific requirements.
 Develop scalable products and platform capabilities that work across Stripe’s ecosystem, including integrations, connector apps, marketplaces, and Connect platforms.
 Partner across Stripe to create coherent end-to-end experiences spanning calculation, collection, reporting, and tax management.
 Use customer insight, market context, data, and technical understanding to prioritize investments and make clear tradeoffs.
 Align senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners around a shared product direction, measurable outcomes, and an execution plan.
 What success looks like 
 You will help make Stripe Tax a product businesses can rely on as they scale. Merchants should be able to confidently answer “yes” to questions such as:
 Can I use Stripe Tax for my business and the locations where I sell?
 Does Stripe Tax support the taxes and business models that apply to me?
 Can it calculate tax accurately for my registrations, exemptions, customers, products, and fulfillment model?
 Is it fast, reliable, and easy for my team to operate?
 Does it work with the other Stripe products, platforms, and integrations my business depends on?
 Who you are 
 You are a product leader who is comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-stakes spaces where customer needs, regulatory complexity, technical constraints, and commercial opportunity intersect. You can translate a broad mission into a focused strategy, build alignment across teams, and deliver meaningful products over multiple horizons.
 You likely have:
 Significant product management experience, including ownership of complex, platform-oriented, or technically deep products.
 A track record of setting strategy and delivering multi-team initiatives with measurable business and customer impact.
 Strong judgment in prioritizing across customer needs, market opportunities, operational complexity, and engineering investment.
 Experience working closely with engineering and design partners to build reliable, scalable products.
 The ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders and to align diverse partners around a shared direction.
 Curiosity about global commerce, financial infrastructure, tax, compliance, payments, marketplaces, or developer platforms. Direct domain experience is helpful but not required.
 A customer-first mindset and the ability to turn complex requirements into simple, effective product experiences.
 Why this role 
 Tax is a fundamental challenge for businesses that sell across borders, channels, and business models. Stripe Tax has the opportunity to remove that complexity, helping businesses launch faster, expand with confidence, and operate globally.
 This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of global commerce, financial infrastructure, and product platform strategy. You will shape how Stripe Tax evolves to serve the next generation of internet businesses.

 Support Technologies builds the products, platforms, and capabilities behind Stripe’s support experiences. The team helps users resolve issues quickly, supports internal teams, and creates reusable technology that improves support across Stripe.
 This role focuses on the complex support needs of Platforms and Connect. Platforms, connected accounts, and their customers each have different relationships with Stripe, access levels, and responsibilities. Resolving an issue often requires understanding who owns the account, which permissions apply, how products are configured, and which party should provide support.
 The team is building the foundations for more contextual support across this multi-party ecosystem. A key part of the work is improving Stripe’s customer-facing AI agent so it can understand these relationships, handle complex cases, and provide accurate, personalized resolutions at scale.
 What you’ll do
 As a Product Manager for Support Experience, you will be responsible for improving the outcomes of Stripe’s user-facing AI agent that holds 100k+ conversations per week. You’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, solving problems for businesses and consumers, and redefining what great can look like. You’ll directly build agent capabilities to solve real-world user problems. That means getting hands-on with prompts, evals, skills, tools and the machinery that lets you introspect and identify opportunities within the conversational experience.
 Responsibilities
 Develop the product strategy and roadmap for Support Technologies serving Platform and Connect use cases.
 Build a deep understanding of the needs of platform operators, connected accounts, Stripe support teams, and platform support teams.
 Improve the capabilities and effectiveness of Stripe’s user-facing AI agent for Platform and Connect support experiences.
 Identify recurring support problems and translate them into reusable product, platform, and AI agent capabilities.
 Build, ship, and iterate on the prompts, skills, tools, and evaluations that enable the AI agent to solve real-world user problems.
 Improve how account relationships, roles, permissions, product configurations, and support history inform routing and resolution across AI and human-assisted support.
 Build tools that help the AI agent and support teams understand complex Platform and Connect issues and take the right next action.
 Enable platforms to support their connected accounts more effectively through appropriate tooling, visibility, automation, and contextual guidance.
 Help clarify whether Stripe, the platform, or another party is responsible for resolving a user’s issue, and route the issue accordingly.
 Create continuous improvement loops that turn insights from AI agent conversations and support interactions into scaled solutions.
 Partner with Platform, Connect, and conversational AI product teams to incorporate support capabilities into critical product journeys.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.  
 Minimum requirements
 7+ years of product management experience, excluding internships and co-ops.
 Deep user empathy and a high bar for user experience.
 Experience leading cross-team initiatives from ideation through execution.
 Experience leading technical products or a background in computer science or a similar field.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.

stripe:8231234.title: Product Manager, Foreign Exchange
stripe:8231234.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach. 
 About the team 
 The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.
 Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.
 Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.
 A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.
 This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.
 Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.
 We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.
 What you’ll do 
 We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.
 You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.
 You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.
 Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.
 You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.
 The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.
 You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.
 Responsibilities 
 Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.
 Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX a

stripe:8264005.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Risk
stripe:8264005.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business models. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing some of the most important work of your career. You can read more about the business we’re building and what we’re looking forward to in our annual letter.
 About the team
 The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.
 Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.
 At Stripe’s scale—$1.9T in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, across millions of businesses—we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.
 What you’ll do
 As a Senior Staff Product Manager for Risk, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.
 You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.
 You will partner closely with Risk leadership to shape the organization’s strategy, vision, and most important investments. As a senior member of Stripe’s product community, you will also coach other PMs, raise the quality of product thinking across Risk, and advance the product management discipline across Stripe.
 Responsibilities
 Identify high-leverage problems that cut across teams, turn ambiguity into clear product and technical direction, and establish measurable outcomes.
 Lead major cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives from initial shaping through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
 Lead changes to Risk’s approach to leveraging data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.
 Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and ML leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.
 Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively, while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.
 Partner with Risk leadership to define multi-year strategy, identify the organization’s most important bets, and make clear investment and sequencing decisions.
 Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolving difficult tradeoffs and driving progress without relying on formal authority.
 Coach and mentor PMs across Risk, helping them strengthen their product judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, and execution.
 Advance the product management discipline across Stripe by raising the bar for how we define problems, develop strategy, partner with technical teams, and deliver complex cross-organizational work.
 Who you are
 We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. You are deeply curious and stay at the forefront of advances in AI and technology, finding practical ways to apply them to our most challenging problems.

stripe:8267105.title: Product Manager, Global Self-Serve Product
stripe:8267105.desc:
Product Manager, Global Self-Serve Product
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The Global Self-Serve Product team's goal is to make Stripe the #1 self-serve financial infrastructure provider for users outside the U.S. We drive product-led growth for the millions of users who adopt Stripe without a sales relationship, and we own self-serve activation goals across our ex-US business.
 We're a cross-functional team of Engineers, Data Scientists, Growth Marketing Managers, Designers, and Product Managers, organized around three focus areas:
 Growing our self-serve domestic business across a portfolio of our core, mature markets
 Growing cross-border self-serve business across the next wave of emerging markets and launching bespoke registration, onboarding and upsell pathways for new markets
 Raising the bar on the quality of the localized experience of our international users by building and improving our localization platform at scale
 About the role
 Most of Stripe's future users outside the US will never speak to a salesperson—they'll discover, sign up, and scale on Stripe entirely on their own. Getting that self-serve journey right, in every market and language, is one of the biggest growth opportunities ahead of us.
 We're looking for a Product Manager to own self-serve activation and growth across our ex-US business. You'll set the strategy for how we win self-serve users in international markets and then make it real—turning funnel data and customer insight into a sequenced roadmap, and shipping the experiments and features that move the metrics.
 The right person for this role thinks like a growth PM and a founder: you're fluent in funnels and experimentation, you have genuine taste for 0-to-1 product, and you move fast under ambiguity. You bring deep user empathy to localizing Stripe with contextual relevance, and you think in systems and platforms—turning experimental features into scaled growth levers 
 What you'll do
 Own the self-serve growth roadmap: identify the highest-leverage opportunities to grow activation across our ex-US markets, and build the case for investment
 Build a deep understanding of our customers—from bootstrapped solopreneurs to well-funded founders—synthesizing funnel metrics, experiment results, and time in the product into sharp hypotheses about what will drive growth
 Partner with engineering to ship—you'll drive specs, prioritization, and execution with a high degree of hands-on involvement, and run experiments to build conviction in your roadmap
 Scale what works: take wins proven in small samples and roll them out through our localization and recommendation platforms, so the right experience reaches each market and use case
 Collaborate with Stripe's global product teams to ensure regional needs are reflected in platform decisions, and advocate for regional investment at the right moments
 Who you are
 You have 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent shipping 0-to-1 products
 You reason from first principles—breaking ambiguous growth problems down to fundamentals, forming a sharp point of view, and moving fast under uncertainty with the ownership of a founder
 You're data-savvy: fluent in funnels, metrics, and experimentation, you let the numbers sharpen your instincts, and you know when a test earns conviction and when it only adds noise
 You have strong product taste and are technically comfortable—you sweat the details of a localized experience (message clarity, contextual guidance) and can engage credibly with engineers on API design and system tradeoffs
 You're an exceptional communicator—verbal and written—who can influence without authority across a matrixed organization
 You're based in Singapore or have a strong reason to be
 Why Stripe
 Stripe is still early in its presence outside the US, which means the person in this role will have genuine influence over how we show up in some of the world's most important emerging markets. You'll have the scope of a startup with the resources of a company that processes hundreds of billions of dollars a year.

 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
 Tide facts:

As we scale Acquiring globally, we need strong monitoring capabilities that protect Tide from avoidable losses while keeping the experience smooth for genuine members.
 ABOUT THE ROLE: 
 As Senior Product Manager for Ongoing Monitoring Acquiring Fraud & Risk, you will own the roadmap for Tide’s acquiring transaction risk monitoring capabilities.
 Working closely with Engineering, Data Science, Fraud Operations, Risk and Acquiring Product teams, you will build and scale real-time monitoring solutions using rules engines, machine learning models and Agentic AI to reduce fraud losses, improve chargeback outcomes and manage Tide’s acquiring risk exposure across card-present and card-not-present payment journeys.

 Creating clear product narratives for senior stakeholders across Product, Risk, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams

 Helping Tide reduce avoidable losses where chargebacks arrive after funds have already been settled to merchants
 Tracking and improving metrics such as recovery rate, chargeback handling time, operational cost per case and manual review effort

 Identifying opportunities to use Agentic AI and automation to improve acquiring fraud and risk operations

About Us 
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

 Wise moves £145B+ annually across borders and customers love us for how easy and how cheap it is. You know who else loves moving money cheaply across borders? Criminals looking to launder proceeds of crime.

We have made great progress in developing a general crime catching machine learning model, and now we need to dig deeper, and get a whole lot more specific. You’ll dive deep into criminal typologies, become an expert in how international crime takes place, and build advanced systems that catch hyper-targeted, regional, criminal behaviour.

 AML Recall measures how much of the crime we actually catch. We want this to be as high as possible, and are rapidly expanding our coverage of hyper specific crime detection in addition to our already strong general model.

 Shape an important product area with the autonomy to set direction and accountability for its results.
 Solve payments problems that span technology, customer experience, commercial needs and regulation.

 Create tools and frameworks that empower teams to design their specific workflows, accelerating time to market and offering customizable complexity.

We serve businesses of every size, from high-growth startups to global enterprises, processing high-volume transactions across Southeast Asia and beyond, with more markets on our global expansion roadmap.

ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.


Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.




If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.



Location Portugal | Compensation package €75,000 - €90,000 base + Bonus + Share Options + Benefits | Ways of working remote with quarterly visits to our London office



About the Role

We are looking for a Lead AI Product Manager to own Telematics at Zego. Our proprietary telematics is how we understand the way people actually drive, and the ratings it produces shape pricing, risk management and claims across our whole book.

You’ll own the telematics stack as a product: the SDKs that capture driving data, the processing that turns it into trips, events and scores, and the Risk Management capabilities that act on them. You’ll set the 6-12 month direction across these teams and make the build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls on sensors, data sources and models.

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Pricing, Claims and Zego’s Leadership Team, champion an experiment-first culture, and mentor Product Managers across the organisation.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - Set the six-to-12-month Telematics strategy across the SDKs, data processing and Risk Management, including the build, buy or partner calls on sensors, data and models.

 - Own data quality at the source, setting the standards for trip recording, location accuracy, battery impact and stability that every score depends on.

 - Own the product side of our scoring models with Data Science, so the score is accurate, explainable and safe to change on a live book.

 - Lead Risk Management, defining how we act on driving behaviour - from price adjustments to interventions and cancellations - balancing loss ratio with fair customer outcomes.

 - Turn driving data into P&L impact with Pricing, Underwriting, Claims and Fraud, through sharper risk selection, fairer prices and better fraud detection.

 - Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, even when changes touch price and live policies.

 - Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team’s output, from trip-data analysis to automated data and model monitoring.

 - Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.



What You’ll Need to Be Successful

 - Strategic product leadership. Significant experience leading product strategy across multiple teams or domains in a high-growth environment, with decisions that moved business-level metrics.

 - Data, sensor or ML products. You’ve built products on behavioural, location or sensor data - ideally telematics, mobility or IoT - and understand how signals become models, and models become decisions.

 - Technical depth. Comfortable engaging engineers on mobile SDKs, data pipelines and ML pipelines, enough to make informed strategic bets.

 - Commercial and risk fluency. Deep understanding of pricing levers, risk modelling and loss ratios, and credible with Actuarial, Finance and Leadership.

 - Data mastery. You are as comfortable in Snowflake as you are in a strategy review, and you can interrogate model performance, not just read a dashboard.

 - Experiment-first operator. You have built experiment cultures, not just run individual tests.

 - You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.



Pay Transparency

At Zego, we are committed to pay transparency and equal pay practices. In compliance with EU pay transparency regulations, we proactively disclose salary information for all open positions to ensure fairness and clarity in our recruitment process. We believe transparency builds trust and helps candidates make informed decisions about their careers with us.

Working in a fast-paced Agile environment, our team thrives on innovation, cross-functional collaboration, and driving measurable outcomes.

We’re building a product organisation where AI isn’t a buzzword - it’s how we work. From rapid prototyping with generative AI to using machine learning models that power our core pricing, our PMs operate at the frontier of what technology can do for insurance.

From enhancing pricing models to streamlining digital experiences, our Product team is instrumental in shaping the future of insurance.

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager who combines strategic depth with a hands-on builder’s instinct. You’ll own strategic workstreams that span multiple teams and business domains, defining the 6-12 month product direction and shaping how Zego’s products evolve to meet ambitious commercial targets.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and leadership. You’ll define new product mechanics and revenue models. You’ll make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations that shape Zego’s competitive position.  - Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team's output, not just your own.

 - Design the product metrics and dashboards the business runs on, and use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground every strategic decision.

 - Own company-level programmes with direct P&L impact, accountable for commercial outcomes rather than feature delivery.

 - Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.

About the Role

You’ll own a growth domain, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping shape the longer-term growth strategy. You’ll find the levers that matter most and run a high-velocity programme of experiments to pull them - aiming for growth that is profitable, not just big.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term growth strategy.

 - Find the biggest growth levers, diagnosing where customers drop off, hesitate or leave, and sizing each opportunity.

 - Run a high-velocity experimentation engine, with a prioritised backlog of tests and guardrails on customer sentiment and risk quality.

 - Design journeys and loops that compound, from first touch to purchase, renewal and referral.

 - Shape the commercial levers with Pricing and Marketing, from propositions and packaging to channel strategy.

 - Drive profitable growth, with business cases and domain metrics grounded in unit economics, not just volume.

 - Establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain, from generating test variants to automated funnel analysis.

 - Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.



What You’ll Need to Be Successful

 - Experimentation at velocity. Hands-on experience running high-volume A/B testing programmes, with a solid grasp of experiment design and statistics.

 - Funnel expertise. You know how to diagnose a funnel, prioritise the biggest drop-offs and fix them end to end.

 - Data and commercial fluency. Comfortable in Amplitude, Looker or Snowflake, and you know the difference between growth and profitable growth.

 - Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on architecture, APIs and service design. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

 - Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.
